description: This file defines the AudioBufferProcessor class, which manages buffering, synchronization, and event-driven processing of audio streams from user and bot sources, supporting features like sample rate conversion, mono/stereo output, and turn-based audio handling.

classes.name: AudioBufferProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes and buffers audio frames from user and bot sources, providing synchronized and event-driven audio data handling with support for sample rate conversion and mono/stereo configurations.

methods.name: merge_audio_buffers
methods.description: Merges user and bot audio buffers into a single stream, mixing for mono or interleaving for stereo.

methods.name: start_recording
methods.description: Begins recording audio, initializing buffers and state.

methods.name: stop_recording
methods.description: Stops recording and triggers final audio data handlers with buffered audio.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, updates sample rate, manages buffers, and handles turn-based audio events.

methods.name: _update_sample_rate
methods.description: Updates the sample rate based on the start frame.

methods.name: _process_recording
methods.description: Processes audio frames for recording, including resampling and silence insertion.

methods.name: _process_turn_recording
methods.description: Handles turn-based audio recording, managing speaking states and buffering.

methods.name: _call_on_audio_data_handler
methods.description: Calls event handlers with buffered audio data.

methods.name: _buffer_has_audio
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains audio data.

methods.name: _reset_primary_audio_buffers
methods.description: Clears primary user and bot audio buffers.

methods.name: _reset_turn_audio_buffers
methods.description: Clears turn-specific user and bot audio buffers.

methods.name: _align_track_buffers
methods.description: Pads shorter audio track with silence to keep buffers in sync.

methods.name: _resample_input_audio
methods.description: Resamples input audio frames to the target sample rate.

methods.name: _resample_output_audio
methods.description: Resamples output audio frames to the target sample rate.

methods.name: _compute_silence
methods.description: Calculates silence bytes to insert based on time gaps.
